acme-not-a-joke: a Haskell library of primitives to obtain TLS certificates from an ACME provider (RFC 8555) such as Let's Encrypt.

Overview: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/acme-not-a-joke/
Introduction: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/acme-not-a-joke/introducing-acme-not-a-joke.html
What's new in 0.2.0.0: https://lucasdicioccio.github.io/acme-not-a-joke/acme-not-a-joke-0.2.0.0.html

Latest release (2026-10-23): acme-not-a-joke 0.2.0.0, acme-not-a-joke-wai 0.1.0.0, acme-not-a-joke-warp 0.1.0.0.
Capabilities: DNS-01, HTTP-01 and TLS-ALPN-01 (RFC 8737) challenges; wildcard and multi-name orders over DNS-01;
certificate revocation; account key rollover (keyChange); account deactivation; JWS with RS256, ES256/384/512 or EdDSA;
errors as values (Either AcmeError); automatic HTTPS for warp (acme-not-a-joke-warp).
